description: This file declares utility functions related to inotify file descriptor monitoring, specifically for retrieving lists of created files and files matching a mask.

methods.name: GetCreatedFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files created, as detected through an inotify file descriptor.

methods.name: GetFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files matching a specific mask from an inotify file descriptor.
